full_page.content:
1912
FATHER SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 12
Page 15 Cont.
Sept. 9th Fr. Venantius from Pitt St. and Fr. Martin from St. John Bapt. in 30th St. visited our Monastery with Rev. Fr. Joseph &. Gregor from Cuba. - Edified by children.
Sept. 19th Holy Mass & Christian-wedding at 5 A.M. - Tho's Fagan and Fr. Gorman were the privileged Servers.
Sept 15th-21 Only four Communions of reparation.
Oct. 3rd C O' Hara returned after about two weeks from Monastery, wanting to serve on Sundays. (Eve of Feast of St. Fran- cis)
Oct. 4 Feast of St. Francis and First Friday-good attendence at Holy Communion.
Oct. 7th Student, Jos Raider became homesick and went home; was all right the next day however and so begged to be taken back Oct. 8th.
Oct. 9th School went to St. Joseph's Theatre - a failure.
Oct. 10 Rev. P. Aloysius and Fr. Eitel From N. Y. City visited. -
Oct. 13 Fr. Sol. celebrated M.C. at St. Anthony's Ch. and at 10.15 at Dobbs Ferry.
Oct. 14 Theod. Rosevelt shot in Milwaukee by a Bevarian Fanatic.
Oct. 23rd Rev. Fr. Superior's Name day visitors were Rev. F. Fr. Ex-Prov. Antonine, Fr. John Donovan Guardian from Harlem Our Lady - Fr. Justin, Fr. Venantius and a number of Brothers.
Page 16 Nov. 2nd First stones for new Church delivered - Thomas Walsh.
Nov. 5th Woodrow Wilson elected President of U.S. by Democratic landslide - congratulated by opponents. ·
Nov. 13th Rev. P. Bruno attacked with brights - his old weakness.
